Content:
## Test features and sawstreet. 
So in our reticle design we had 30um on each side to give us the total 60um saw street. 

GF did not honor another 30um and started their test features right there.

Author: anfroholic
Content:
## Dicing Metal
We do not want to dice through features or test patterns. Apparently it loads up the wheel and that causes heat/ time from wheel dressing and other bad things. 

First one, they requested we ask GF to not let test features cross our dicing lines. 
Second one (and I don't even know how/if this is even possible?? but they asked if there was a way for GF to not have metal deposited in the un-shot spaces

Author: 246tnt
Content: In the pic posted with < 50um dimension, AFAICT that's just the polyimide deposition. but you can cut through that, doesn't matter for anything, there is nothing there. The 60.90 is the actual point where things start to matter ( that's the `Metal5` from the guard ring which extends all the way to the edge of the project dies )

we have that little sliver, that was causing all kinds of problems. They asked that we have no features that are taller than they are wide. No sliver there would be best. but that's something we already knew.
